selected_evidence.summary: postgresql installed and initialized on node1; replication settings and replicator role created; node2/node3 built via pg_basebackup -R with standby.signal and primary_conninfo pointing at node1; pg_stat_replication on node1 shows both standbys streaming

selected_evidence.requirement: Replicated data verified consistent before disruption
selected_evidence.summary: Rows inserted on node1 primary appear identically on node2 and node3 standbys

selected_evidence.requirement: Primary loss simulated and standby promoted without data loss
selected_evidence.summary: node2 confirmed at matching WAL LSN before node1 was stopped; node2 promoted to primary (pg_is_in_recovery=f) and accepted a new write while retaining all prior rows including the last one written on node1 pre-failover

selected_evidence.requirement: Remaining standby (node3) repointed to new primary
selected_evidence.summary: node3 primary_conninfo updated to node2, restarted, confirmed streaming from node2 in pg_stat_replication and holding the post-failover row

selected_evidence.requirement: Recovered former primary (node1) rejoins as standby of current primary (node2)
selected_evidence.summary: node1 rebuilt via pg_basebackup -R from node2, started as standby (pg_is_in_recovery=t) with full data, and node2's pg_stat_replication shows both node1 and node3 streaming

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 4d340bf4...; systemctl reboot acknowledged; post-reboot boot_id 9c54dcf4... (changed); postgresql active, standby recovery mode confirmed, all rows present, node2 shows node1 streaming again

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 4d842549...; reboot acknowledged; post-reboot boot_id 26c0dbdc... (changed); postgresql active, standby recovery mode confirmed, all rows present, node2 shows node3 streaming again

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 (primary) restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state as primary
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id cce73776...; reboot acknowledged; post-reboot boot_id abf60f22... (changed); postgresql resumed active as writable primary (pg_is_in_recovery=f), accepted a new write, and both node1 and node3 replicated the new row, proving full cluster recovery
